No need to go to any expensive regular class.] Speaker A: मतलब अपनी ड्यूटी के बाद या चलते फिरते जब फ्री हो तब आपसे बात करूँ? summary: A delivery worker asks an AI avatar how to learn English affordably. The AI avatar recommends the SpeakEasy app for flexible, daily practice via live chat. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app and start a trial for just 1 rupee.
